<!doctype html>
<!--
  iris-reveal demo. Full-bleed mount on a dark token stage: the iris opens
  from the upper-left third of the 1920x1080 frame with the blue accent rim,
  proving the reveal works as a full-frame transition with an off-center
  origin and the classic grayscale-to-color register.
-->
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>iris-reveal Demo</title>
    <style>
      * {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      html,
      body {
        width: 1920px;
        height: 1080px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: var(--bg, #05070d);
      }

      #root {
        --bg: #080b14;
        --fg: #f8fafc;
        --muted: #94a3b8;
        --surface: #182033;
        --border: #3b4863;
        --brand: #22c55e;
        --accent: #38bdf8;
        --accent-2: #c5a3ff;
        --font-display: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
        --font-body: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
        --radius: 22px;
        --space-1: 8px;
        --space-2: 16px;
        --space-3: 32px;
        position: relative;
        width: 1920px;
        height: 1080px;
        overflow: hidden;
        background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, #10182b 0%, var(--bg, #080b14) 72%);
      }

      .mount-stage {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        left: 0;
        top: 0;
        container-type: size;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div
      id="root"
      data-composition-id="iris-reveal-demo"
      data-start="0"
      data-width="1920"
      data-height="1080"
      data-duration="3.5"
      data-fps="30"
    >
      <div
        id="iris-reveal-mount"
        class="mount-stage clip"
        data-composition-id="iris-reveal"
        data-composition-src="data:text/html;base64,"
       
        data-start="0"
        data-duration="3.5"
        data-track-index="0"
        data-width="1920"
        data-height="1080"
      ></div>
    </div>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.14.2/dist/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <script>
      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["iris-reveal-demo"] = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
